name: Google Meitner Energy Center data center (Gray and Roberts counties)
summary: Google data center being built alongside new dedicated generation at the Meitner Energy Center in Gray and Roberts counties in the Texas Panhandle; Google's location list shows a Pampa site in development. Google and Intersect, the energy developer Google closed on buying in March 2026, announced construction on 4 June 2026. The complex pairs the data center with more than 1 GW of wind, solar and battery storage, and on-site gas firming covers a minority of demand. The data center is designed for air cooling. Google has not disclosed the compute load, cost or opening date. An 800-acre Caprock Workforce Hub in Wheeler County is planned to house up to 3,500 workers.

location.note: Town centroid of Pampa via Nominatim. The project spans Gray and Roberts counties, and Google's location list includes a Pampa, Texas site in development that matches it; no site address or parcel has been published.

parties.name: Intersect
parties.note: Announced construction of the Meitner Energy Center jointly with Google; Intersect's business is pairing large loads with dedicated generation. Google closed its acquisition of Intersect in March 2026.

metrics.note: Combined co-located wind, solar and battery storage capacity; the data center's own load has not been disclosed.

milestones.note: Google (Alphabet) completed its acquisition of Intersect.
The 4 June 2026 announcement launched construction; no exact groundbreaking date was given.
